prerequisites: terminal digest-bound nine-seed P2 causal audit
terminal Qwen3-4B adaptive-quota RULER audit regardless of outcome
terminal baseline Qwen3-4B LongMemEval audit regardless of official-judge availability
verified frozen LongMemEval dataset, source, model, and fixed-baseline selection
execution_policy: generate all 500 frozen examples under both arms; prerequisite outcomes and judge availability never select, cancel, truncate, or reorder examples

benchmark.name: LongMemEval
benchmark.history_protocol: full orig-session natural-language history with no external retrieval, compression, or truncation before context-fit classification
benchmark.paired_unit: the same frozen question with identical rendered history, current-date suffix, question, and exact token ids
benchmark.overflow_policy: retain unsupported-context as an intention-to-evaluate failure; never truncate

natural-adaptive-quota+pins.layer_signal: normalized entropy concentration of z-scored current-layer scorer values
natural-adaptive-quota+pins.causal_prior: running mean of earlier-layer concentrations only

scorer_selection.rule: reuse the frozen score-compatible Qwen selection without LongMemEval outcome inspection

cache_lifecycle_contract.current_question_tokens: append identically after history compression without adaptive reallocation
cache_lifecycle_contract.generation_tokens: decode identically under the arm-specific post-prefill cache
per_successful_generation_audit: all 36 initial layer allocations in causal order
configured and observed initial total kept tokens
score concentration and controller time per layer
initial hot-resident bytes, peak HBM, latency, generated tokens, and stop reason

official_metric_contract.primary_metric: official GPT-4o judge accuracy overall and by question type
official_metric_contract.blocked_record_policy: retain the complete local-model response and physical measurements with failure_type judge-blocked; do not convert judge unavailability into a model-quality failure
official_metric_contract.auxiliary_metric_policy: no deterministic, lexical, embedding, or local-LLM proxy may replace the official metric
official_metric_contract.paid_judge_policy: a later explicit paid-judge cohort requires a separately frozen manifest and OPENAI_API_KEY; never invoke it implicitly

failure_reporting.successful_generation_with_blocked_judge: status failure, failure_type judge-blocked, score null, response and generation measurements retained
failure_reporting.operational_failure_policy: retain every frozen example; never silently retry or drop it

reporting.generation_completion: report response-generation coverage, operational failures, token lengths, latency, HBM, hot-resident bytes, and quota audits by arm and question type
reporting.quality: report official quality as unverified until an explicit paid-judge artifact exists
reporting.reason_excluded_from_adaptive_confirmati: the official paid judge is unavailable and no proxy substitution is permitted

claim_boundary: This cohort can establish paired response-generation completion and initial-prefill physical-budget behavior for fixed+pins versus the causal layer-quota heuristic on LongMemEval. Without the frozen official GPT-4o judge it provides no model-quality success, non-inferiority, or negative-result claim; it does not establish continuous adaptive reallocation, cross-model transfer, or official DeepSeek-V4 behavior.
